关键词: Termination of a Material Definitive Agreement
主要内容: Blonder Tongue Laboratories Inc received notice on May 29, 2018, that Mountainblue Jake Brown Realty LLC was exercising its right to terminate the previously-announced Agreement of Sale between the parties. The Sale Agreement involved the sale of the Company’s Old Bridge, New Jersey facility and a leaseback arrangement for a portion of the facility. The Company intends to continue pursuing the sale of the Old Bridge Facility through a sale/leaseback or outright sale transaction.
